push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.8 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.8. That's what showing up looks like, and it looks good on you.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes, your busiest match yet. The ball kept finding you, and that's no coincidence.
+ Won 4 of 8 tackles (up from your usual 26%). Clean as a whistle and twice as loud.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.

THE BAD
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 4 (best was PhogsToffees's 1). That's the leak in the boat.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50% (13 of 26). That has to be the floor, and we never visit the floor again. Back to basics: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Session plan: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.

tuxedo_slide, take this with you: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 7.2
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.2. Not your best, not your worst, and definitely not your last. Let's dig in.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Shots on target 4, up from your usual 1. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ Passes attempted 17, from 1 in your previous match. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ 2-2 draw. Neither team blinked.

THE BAD
- 59% passing (10 of 17, down from your usual 81%). Next rep: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Training homework: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- 0 goals from 4 on target. Let's sharpen this: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. Promise it's worth it.
- 0.7 below usual. No panic, just practice.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was tuxedo_slide's 3). Here's a thought: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

Warm-up idea: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Stay curious about your game. - Coach Lasso
